decision: Confirm that the branch-aligned single-lineage Preview preserves the current Production GI-088 v1.9 visible-response and background-task experience while retaining the Stage 1-4 source-main contracts.

roles.objectiveChecks: Verify exact deployment identity, runtime mode/strategy/model, authenticated event-centered start, one valid SSE response, visible complete response, background-task handoff, and unchanged protected boundaries.
roles.codexReview: Assess only the controlled response against the current v1.9 response-first contract and report pass, minor, or fail with evidence boundaries.
roles.productOwner: Retains final experience and Production release authority.

stopPoints: transport failure before the application response
runtime mode, strategy, or model mismatch
invalid SSE or structured application error
missing visible complete response or background-task handoff

result.stopReason: The branch-scoped token written through standard input did not match the application value. The same private token must be stored without a trailing newline and deployed under a new identity.
